# SEO/AEO/GEO Analyzer

> Open-source Python toolkit for SEO, AEO, GEO, keyword-gap, performance, Google Search Console, and generated HTML report analysis.

Important notes:
- Do not commit `.env`, API credentials, OAuth tokens, generated reports, or private customer data.
- Use `python -m pytest -q` before merging code changes.
- Generated report HTML must escape untrusted JSON or API-sourced values.
- Example configs use public brands only: Allbirds, Asana, and Duolingo.

## Project Docs

- [README](README.md): Setup, usage, examples, maintenance status, and roadmap.
- [AI readiness guide](docs/AI_READINESS.md): Google AI search guidance, WebMCP, Lighthouse agentic browsing, and llms.txt notes.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and security expectations.
- [Contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and pull request workflow.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Notable project changes.

## Entry Points

- [run_analysis.py](run_analysis.py): Interactive and automatic workflow orchestrator.
- [collect_data.py](collect_data.py): Sitemap, metadata, and social profile collection.
- [dataforseo_collection.py](dataforseo_collection.py): DataForSEO keyword and competitive data collection.
- [google_integration.py](google_integration.py): Google Search Console and GA4 integration.
- [generate_report.py](generate_report.py): HTML report generation.
- [export_data.py](export_data.py): CSV, Excel, and PDF export.
